title: Case: Customer cannot print a return label
context: The approved return offers a printer-free QR token at a specified staffed counter. The token is inert and usable only within the fictional exercise.
initial_request: I do not own a printer. Could you arrange the QR return option and tell me which counter accepts it?

events.body: My parcel DL-28420 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Hi, any update on DL-73540? It was meant to come Thursday. Thanks.

RT-7813 for TG-3696, original shipment DL-6073, is approved. Our return service supports printer-free QR presentation at Copperfin Returns Counter, 10:00–18:00 UTC. The token must be issued by returns; no customer printer is required.
Route plan for depot CT-9 published for Thursday. 35 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please issue the printer-free QR token for approved RT-7813 and confirm a supported drop-off counter and its hours.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-032: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
